R-Ladies Abuja

A local chapter of R-Ladies Global — empowering women and gender minorities to thrive in R and data science across Nigeria.

Our Story

Who We Are

R-Ladies Abuja is the Nigerian Federal Capital Territory chapter of R-Ladies Global. Founded in 2021, we are a community of R users, data scientists, statisticians, researchers, and learners based in Abuja and across Nigeria — united by a shared commitment to making data science more inclusive, accessible, and impactful.

Since our founding, we have hosted 34+ events covering a wide range of topics: from the fundamentals of the tidyverse and R Markdown through to advanced machine learning, Shiny app development, geospatial analysis, text mining, natural language processing, and Quarto publishing. Our webinars bring in expert speakers from Nigeria and around the world — and every session is recorded and made freely available on YouTube.

We welcome everyone who identifies as a woman or gender minority, at any stage of their R journey — whether you have never opened RStudio or you are a seasoned package developer. Come as you are.
